collision_shape_interaction.known: 01F7:8D31 calls 01F7:393C and applies the original x-overlap and 16-aligned y-overlap gate. A controlled type 0x6F overlap reaches subtype case 1, publishes DS:612E=9, increments DS:880C by 10 and DS:881C by 50, then clears object+0x18.

animation_table.known: WERBE.BOB is a four-record static table: slots 607/608/609/610 map to records 0/1/2/3 with dimensions 26x34, 21x22, 22x22, and 15x25 (all origin 0,0); 8D20 has no animation advance for pickups.

death_removal.known: The original overlap path clears object+0x18 (callback becomes 0000) after the subtype effect; target-vs-inert mutations independently remove the objects. Level persistence and respawn remain outside this callback.

cross_world_variants.known: Resource-selector traces capture WERBE.BOB in W1, W2, W3, W4, and W5 contexts; slots 607-610 retain the same four-record table.
